name: tangle
description: Claude-led, Codex-powered local engineering with isolated workers and review-gated integration.
long_description: Tangle lets Claude Desktop remain the engineering lead while it delegates scoped implementation work to parallel Codex workers. It attaches safely to clean or dirty Git sessions, uses private worktrees, enforces file ownership, and requires Claude review before an accepted delta can be integrated. The runtime and dashboard stay on your computer.
